_about: Aero parts for each car are made by models/tools/prep_aero.py (fitted against the car with ray casts). Splitter, side skirts, diffuser and exhaust tips are modelled by the script itself; the wing and the lip/ducktail come from these downloads (CC BY 4.0). Generated files are not committed.
